exposure: serum heavy metal concentrations (manganese, nickel, copper, zinc, arsenic, cadmium, lead)
cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women with preeclampsia and 160 pregnant women with normal deliveries recruited from Dongguan Songshan Lake Central Hospital.
finding: Serum E2, P, T, Cort, and Cort/Cor were identified as potential mediators in the association between certain heavy metals (Mn, Cu, Zn) and preeclampsia, with some heavy metals and hormones showing direct associations with PE.
